{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history includes positive sentiment (e.g., >0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when model shows persistent overshoots after recent price spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if 3-5 consecutive days show high forecast error, adjust next forecast toward historical mean of last 15 days.",
    "Increase forecast lag sensitivity: if sentiment is neutral or negative, delay peak forecasts by 1-2 days to avoid overreaction.",
    "When true outcome is significantly below forecast (e.g., >15% under), reduce future forecast by 10-20% to avoid further underestimation.",
    "If forecast consistently overestimates true outcome by >10% over 3+ consecutive days, apply downward correction rule with exponential decay weighting.",
    "For sentiment history with 0.25 or above, increase forecast volatility penalty: reduce confidence in short-term forecasts by 15%."
  ]
}
